description: An `if` used as a value: each branch one value, `else if` chain, no `else` renders nothing; re-rendered when its cell changes.
rationale: §17.6.2: "An if-as-expression arm body SHALL produce its result value via a `lift` statement, or by being exactly one expression"; §17.6.10: "When the `else` is absent, the false path SHALL contribute `not` per §17.6.4 and SHALL render as nothing" and "A value-form SHALL re-evaluate reactively on change of any reactive cell it reads." Ruled S469 "three spec-follow-up opens" (if-branch: "Keep { e }, lift once a statement").
